title: Walking On Sunshine Morning
text_raw:
[Verse]
Walking on sunshine every single morning
The sun is shining bright and warm on my face
Happy feelings fill my heart with joy today

[Chorus]
Sunshine sunshine walking in the golden light
Morning morning brings a happy new day
I feel the warmth of sunshine on my skin

title: Rain And Thunder Night
text_raw:
[Verse]
Rain is falling hard against the window pane
Thunder rumbles loud across the darkened sky
Lightning flashes bright then fades into the night

[Chorus]
Rain rain pouring down upon the empty street
Thunder thunder shaking every window frame
Storm clouds gather heavy over the quiet town

title: Mountain Climbing Journey
text_raw:
[Verse]
Climbing up the mountain path with heavy boots
The summit calls to me from far above the clouds
Every step I take brings me closer to the peak

[Chorus]
Mountain mountain rising tall against the sky
Climbing climbing higher toward the rocky summit
I will reach the mountain peak before the sunset falls

title: Ocean Waves Forever
text_raw:
[Verse]
Ocean waves are crashing on the sandy shore
Salty water sprays across the weathered rocks
Seagulls cry above the endless rolling sea

[Chorus]
Ocean ocean waves keep crashing all night long
Waves waves rolling gently on the sandy shore
The deep blue ocean stretches far beyond the sea
